name: Kirac Galvaniz Telekominikasyon Metal Makine Insaat Elektrik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Kirac Galvaniz Telekominikasyon Metal Makine Insaat Elektrik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a guardrail supplier company in Turkey. The company provides steel guardrail systems, noise barrier systems, solar energy systems, and motorcyclist protection systems, as well as hot dip galvanizing services. It also offers other products, such as traffic sign and boards, overhead sign carrier and intersection direction information signs, omega profiles, trailers with warning lights, pedestrian handrails, crash cushion systems, and pedestrian overpass construction systems.
